causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Then from 11.35 pm demand picked up due to hot water load and prices exceeded $5,000/MWh as forecast.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: There was little wind generation, dropping to as low as 12 MW. Wind is generally offered in at negative prices.

causes.label: solar_output
causes.quote: By 6 pm wind generation was forecast to fall to 161 MW, 4 hours prior, and solar output would be down to 0 MW by 7.30 pm.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At around 5.10 pm a fire in the Torrens Island power station (TIPS) switchyard saw the Barker Inlet power station disconnected reducing capacity by around 200 MW, all of which was priced below $61/MWh. The fire also limited output from TIPS B to close to minimum generation levels by AEMO to keep the system secure. This effectively removed 540 MW of capacity priced below $250/MWh.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: There was a planned outage of lines in Victoria for major repairs from severe wind damage in 2020 which limited South Australia's ability to import cheaper generation from Victoria.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At times there was as little as 2 MW of high priced capacity needed to meet demand so minor rebidding of capacity from low to high prices contributed to the price exceeding $5,000/MWh.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The outage limited imports into South Australia by around 350 MW across the Heywood interconnector.

constraints_named.quote: constr off out of merit order - s_tipsb_270

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: The outage limited imports into South Australia by around 350 MW across the Heywood interconnector.

intervals.quote: On 12 March 2021 the spot price in South Australia exceeded $5,000/MWh 6 times between 6 pm and midnight.
intervals.text: 7:30 pm, 8 pm, 8:30 pm, 11 pm, 11:30 pm, midnight

network_outages.quote: At around 5.10 pm a fire in the Torrens Island power station (TIPS) switchyard saw the Barker Inlet power station disconnected reducing capacity by around 200 MW, all of which was priced below $61/MWh. The fire also limited output from TIPS B to close to minimum generation levels by AEMO to keep the system secure. This effectively removed 540 MW of capacity priced below $250/MWh. There was a planned outage of lines in Victoria for major repairs from severe wind damage in 2020 which limited South Australia's ability to import cheaper generation from Victoria.

rebid_set_price.quote: At times there was as little as 2 MW of high priced capacity needed to meet demand so minor rebidding of capacity from low to high prices contributed to the price exceeding $5,000/MWh.
